description: This 3D bar chart illustrates the accuracy scores for different large language models across various reasoning strategies. The horizontal axis represents the reasoning strategy, with categories labeled “Deductive,” “Inductive,” “Abductive,” and “Mix,” ordered alphabetically. The depth axis represents the model, with categories labeled “BARD,” “Davinci-003,” and “Mix,” also ordered alphabetically. The vertical axis is labeled “Accuracy,” with a linear scale ranging from 0 to 0.8, with tick marks at 0.2 intervals. Each bar represents the accuracy score for a specific model and reasoning strategy combination, with the color gradient transitioning from blue to green to yellow. The shortest bar, representing BARD with Deductive reasoning, has an approximate height of 0.25, while the tallest bar, representing Davinci-003 with Mix reasoning, reaches approximately 0.78. The bars are arranged in a grid format, with each cell representing a unique combination of model and reasoning strategy, and no bars are visually emphasized.
